title: Payment service not responding
symptoms: Users receive timeouts on the payment screen
root_cause: DB connection pool was exhausted
resolution: Pool size increased and the connection leak was fixed

title: Checkout fails intermittently
symptoms: About 15% of checkout attempts return a 500 error
root_cause: A downstream inventory call had no timeout and hung under load
resolution: Added a 2s timeout with retry and a circuit breaker around the inventory call

title: Login attempts rejected for valid users
symptoms: Valid users get 'invalid credentials' errors during login
root_cause: Password hashing library was upgraded with an incompatible cost parameter
resolution: Rolled back the library and re-issued a migration for affected hashes

title: API gateway returning 502 errors
symptoms: All API endpoints intermittently return 502 Bad Gateway
root_cause: Upstream keep-alive timeout was shorter than the load balancer idle timeout
resolution: Aligned keep-alive and idle timeouts and enabled connection reuse

title: Search results are stale
symptoms: New products do not appear in search for up to an hour
root_cause: The indexing consumer fell behind due to a poison message it kept retrying
resolution: Added a dead-letter queue and skip logic for malformed messages

title: Notification emails not delivered
symptoms: Order confirmation emails are not being sent to customers
root_cause: The email provider API key expired and was not rotated
resolution: Rotated the API key and added an expiry alert 14 days ahead

title: Cart items disappear after refresh
symptoms: Users report cart contents vanish when the page reloads
root_cause: Session affinity was lost after a node was added and cart lived only in local memory
resolution: Moved cart state to Redis and removed the local in-memory store

title: Order status stuck in pending
symptoms: Orders remain in 'pending' and never transition to 'confirmed'
root_cause: The state machine worker crashed on an unhandled null field and stopped consuming
resolution: Added null guards and a supervisor to restart the worker automatically

title: High latency on product detail pages
symptoms: Product pages take 5-8 seconds to load during peak hours
root_cause: An N+1 query pattern fetched attributes per product in a loop
resolution: Batched the attribute fetch into a single query and added an index

title: Image uploads failing
symptoms: Users cannot upload product images, receiving generic errors
root_cause: The object storage bucket reached its configured quota
resolution: Increased the quota and added a lifecycle policy to expire temp uploads

title: Recommendation widget empty
symptoms: The 'You may also like' section shows no items
root_cause: The model serving endpoint returned empty results after a bad model deploy
resolution: Rolled back to the previous model version and added output validation

title: SMS one-time codes delayed
symptoms: OTP codes arrive several minutes late or not at all
root_cause: The SMS provider throttled traffic due to a spike from a retry storm
resolution: Added exponential backoff and a per-user send rate limit

title: Database replication lag spike
symptoms: Read replicas serve data several minutes behind the primary
root_cause: A large batch delete generated excessive replication traffic
resolution: Chunked the delete into smaller batches and throttled it

title: Cache stampede on homepage
symptoms: Homepage latency spikes every time the cache expires
root_cause: Many requests recomputed the same expensive value simultaneously on expiry
resolution: Added a mutex lock and stale-while-revalidate caching

title: Certificate expired on public API
symptoms: Clients get TLS handshake failures on all HTTPS calls
root_cause: The TLS certificate expired and auto-renewal had silently failed
resolution: Renewed the certificate and fixed the ACME renewal cron plus added monitoring

title: Disk full on logging node
symptoms: Log ingestion stopped and services report write errors
root_cause: Log rotation was misconfigured and old logs were never deleted
resolution: Fixed rotation config and added a disk usage alert at 80%

title: Duplicate charges on retries
symptoms: Some customers were charged twice for a single order
root_cause: Payment requests lacked idempotency keys and retries created duplicates
resolution: Introduced idempotency keys and deduplication on the provider side

title: Inventory oversold on flash sale
symptoms: More units sold than available during a limited promotion
root_cause: A race condition allowed concurrent decrements below zero
resolution: Switched to atomic conditional updates and added stock reservation

title: Webhook events lost
symptoms: Partner webhook events are occasionally not processed
root_cause: The webhook consumer acknowledged messages before processing completed
resolution: Moved acknowledgement to after successful processing and added retries

title: Analytics dashboard shows zeros
symptoms: All analytics charts render zero for the current day
root_cause: The ETL job failed silently after an upstream schema change
resolution: Added schema validation and failure alerting to the ETL pipeline

title: Slow admin panel
symptoms: The admin dashboard takes over 10 seconds to load
root_cause: A missing index caused full table scans on the audit log table
resolution: Added a composite index on (created_at, actor_id)

title: User profile updates not saving
symptoms: Profile edits appear to succeed but revert after reload
root_cause: A read replica was used for the post-write read before replication caught up
resolution: Routed read-after-write to the primary for the affected endpoints

title: Rate limiter blocking legitimate traffic
symptoms: Mobile app users hit 429 errors during normal usage
root_cause: The rate limit key was set to the shared NAT IP of a mobile carrier
resolution: Switched the rate limit key to authenticated user ID

title: Background jobs piling up
symptoms: The job queue depth grows continuously and jobs are delayed
root_cause: A single slow external API call blocked the entire worker pool
resolution: Isolated the slow call into its own queue and added concurrency limits

title: Feature flag caused outage
symptoms: A new feature flag rollout took down the checkout flow
root_cause: The flag defaulted to on for all users without a gradual rollout
resolution: Reverted the flag and enforced staged rollout in the flag system

title: Memory leak in image service
symptoms: The image processing service crashes with OOM every few hours
root_cause: Decoded image buffers were never released due to a reference held in a cache
resolution: Fixed the reference retention and added a bounded LRU cache

title: Timezone bug in reports
symptoms: Daily reports show data shifted by several hours
root_cause: Timestamps were stored in local time instead of UTC
resolution: Normalized all timestamps to UTC and converted at display time

title: Password reset links invalid
symptoms: Users clicking reset links get 'token expired or invalid'
root_cause: Token TTL was accidentally set to 30 seconds instead of 30 minutes
resolution: Corrected the TTL configuration and added a test to lock the value

title: Third-party payment provider outage
symptoms: All card payments fail with provider connection errors
root_cause: The primary payment provider had a regional outage
resolution: Failed over to the secondary provider and added automatic failover

title: Shipping cost calculation wrong
symptoms: Some orders show incorrect or zero shipping cost
root_cause: A rounding error in the weight-to-cost conversion produced wrong tiers
resolution: Fixed the rounding logic and added unit tests for boundary weights

title: Product images broken
symptoms: Product images show as broken across the site
root_cause: A CDN cache purge misfired and served 404s for valid assets
resolution: Repopulated the cache and added origin fallback on 404

title: Session expires too quickly
symptoms: Users are logged out after only a few minutes
root_cause: A misconfigured cookie max-age overrode the session TTL
resolution: Aligned cookie max-age with server session TTL

title: Deadlocks during checkout
symptoms: Checkout transactions fail intermittently with deadlock errors
root_cause: Two code paths acquired the same rows in opposite order
resolution: Standardized lock acquisition order and added retry on deadlock

title: Coupon codes not applying
symptoms: Valid coupon codes are rejected at checkout
root_cause: The promotion cache was not invalidated after a rule change
resolution: Added cache invalidation on promotion rule updates

title: Excessive 500 errors after deploy
symptoms: Error rate spiked immediately after the latest deployment
root_cause: A database migration was not applied before the new code went live
resolution: Enforced migrate-before-deploy ordering in the pipeline

title: Search returns irrelevant results
symptoms: Search relevance dropped noticeably for common queries
root_cause: A synonym dictionary update introduced conflicting mappings
resolution: Reverted the synonym change and added a relevance regression test

title: Push notifications not received
symptoms: Mobile push notifications stopped arriving on Android devices
root_cause: The FCM server key was revoked during a credential cleanup
resolution: Reissued the key and moved credentials to the secrets manager

title: Slow API responses under load
symptoms: P99 latency exceeds 3 seconds during traffic spikes
root_cause: Thread pool saturation because blocking IO ran on request threads
resolution: Moved blocking IO to a dedicated pool and increased pool sizing

title: Order emails sent twice
symptoms: Customers receive duplicate order confirmation emails
root_cause: The email job was triggered by two overlapping event handlers
resolution: Consolidated to a single handler and added idempotent send tracking

title: Currency conversion incorrect
symptoms: Prices in some currencies are off by a large factor
root_cause: The exchange rate feed returned stale rates during a provider hiccup
resolution: Added staleness checks and a fallback rate source

title: Failed to scale during peak
symptoms: The service could not scale up and shed traffic during a peak
root_cause: Autoscaling was capped by an outdated max replica limit
resolution: Raised the max replica limit and reviewed scaling thresholds

title: Corrupted data in user records
symptoms: Some user records show mixed data from other users
root_cause: A caching layer keyed entries by an insufficiently unique key
resolution: Fixed the cache key to include the full user identifier and purged the cache

title: Slow cold starts on serverless
symptoms: First requests after idle periods take several seconds
root_cause: Large dependency bundle inflated function initialization time
resolution: Trimmed dependencies and enabled provisioned concurrency

title: DNS resolution failures
symptoms: Services intermittently fail to reach internal dependencies
root_cause: The DNS cache TTL was too high and pointed to a decommissioned host
resolution: Lowered TTLs and added health-based DNS records

title: Refunds not processed
symptoms: Refund requests are accepted but never reach the provider
root_cause: The refund queue consumer was accidentally scaled to zero
resolution: Restored the consumer and added a queue-depth alert

title: Login page blank on some browsers
symptoms: The login page renders blank on older browser versions
root_cause: A new JavaScript syntax feature was not transpiled for older targets
resolution: Updated the build target and added the browser to the test matrix

title: Report export times out
symptoms: Large report exports fail with a gateway timeout
root_cause: The export ran synchronously within the request lifecycle
resolution: Moved export to an async job with a download link when ready

title: Inconsistent tax calculation
symptoms: Tax amounts differ between the cart and the final invoice
root_cause: Cart and invoice used two different tax rounding strategies
resolution: Unified the tax calculation into a single shared service

title: Elevated error rate on mobile API
symptoms: Mobile clients see a surge of 400 errors after an update
root_cause: A required header was renamed without backward compatibility
resolution: Accepted both header names during a deprecation window

title: Kafka consumer lag growing
symptoms: Event processing lag increases steadily throughout the day
root_cause: A single partition was hot due to a poor partition key choice
resolution: Repartitioned with a better key and increased consumer parallelism

title: Users cannot update payment method
symptoms: Saving a new card fails with a vague error
root_cause: Tokenization calls failed because the vault service certificate was untrusted
resolution: Updated the trust store and pinned the vault certificate

title: Homepage banner not updating
symptoms: Editors publish a new banner but the old one still shows
root_cause: A CDN edge cache held the page far longer than intended
resolution: Reduced the cache TTL for CMS pages and added purge on publish

title: Order history missing recent orders
symptoms: Recently placed orders do not appear in order history
root_cause: A read query filtered on a status that new orders had not reached yet
resolution: Broadened the status filter to include pending states

title: Failed background image processing
symptoms: Uploaded images are never resized into thumbnails
root_cause: The thumbnail worker silently died after an unhandled format error
resolution: Added format validation and worker restart with alerting

title: Login rate limiting bypassed
symptoms: Brute force attempts succeed in bypassing rate limits
root_cause: Rate limiting was keyed on username but attempts rotated usernames
resolution: Added IP-based and global rate limits alongside username limits

title: Slow database failover
symptoms: A primary failover took several minutes causing an outage
root_cause: The failover promotion depended on a slow manual step
resolution: Automated promotion and reduced the health check interval

title: Duplicate inventory decrements
symptoms: Stock levels drop by more than the quantity actually ordered
root_cause: A retried order event decremented stock more than once
resolution: Made the decrement idempotent by order and line item

title: Broken links in transactional emails
symptoms: Links in emails point to a staging environment
root_cause: The base URL config was not overridden for production
resolution: Set the correct base URL and added a config validation check

title: Search autocomplete unavailable
symptoms: The autocomplete dropdown stops appearing intermittently
root_cause: The suggestion service ran out of file descriptors under load
resolution: Raised the file descriptor limit and fixed a socket leak

title: Payments delayed at settlement
symptoms: Settlement of captured payments is delayed by hours
root_cause: The settlement batch job overlapped with a heavy reporting job
resolution: Rescheduled the jobs and isolated their database resources

title: Users see other users' notifications
symptoms: Notifications are occasionally delivered to the wrong user
root_cause: A shared connection object leaked user context across requests
resolution: Scoped the context per request and added isolation tests

title: Wishlist not persisting
symptoms: Items added to wishlist are lost after logout
root_cause: Wishlist writes went to a cache that was never flushed to the database
resolution: Added write-through persistence for wishlist changes

title: Gateway health checks flapping
symptoms: Instances are repeatedly marked unhealthy then healthy
root_cause: The health check timeout was shorter than a normal GC pause
resolution: Increased the health check timeout and tuned garbage collection

title: Failed CSV import for catalog
symptoms: Bulk product imports fail on files with special characters
root_cause: The parser assumed ASCII and choked on UTF-8 content
resolution: Switched the parser to UTF-8 and added encoding detection

title: Order confirmation page errors
symptoms: The confirmation page shows an error even when the order succeeded
root_cause: The page tried to load a recommendation service that was down
resolution: Made the recommendation call non-blocking and optional

title: Latency from a noisy neighbor
symptoms: One service degrades whenever another spikes on the same node
root_cause: Two services shared a node without resource limits
resolution: Set CPU and memory limits and spread the pods across nodes

title: Stale pricing shown to users
symptoms: Users see old prices that differ from checkout prices
root_cause: The pricing cache TTL was too long after a price update campaign
resolution: Reduced the TTL and added event-driven cache invalidation

title: Failed to send invoices
symptoms: Monthly invoices are generated but not emailed
root_cause: The invoice PDF generation service ran out of memory on large accounts
resolution: Streamed PDF generation and raised the memory limit

title: Auth tokens rejected after deploy
symptoms: All users are logged out after a deployment
root_cause: The JWT signing key rotated without keeping the previous key for verification
resolution: Kept a key ring with the prior key during rotation windows

title: Slow inventory sync with warehouse
symptoms: Warehouse stock updates take too long to reflect on the site
root_cause: The sync polled a slow external API every minute serially
resolution: Switched to event-driven updates via the warehouse webhook

title: Checkout blocked by fraud filter
symptoms: Legitimate orders are being flagged and blocked
root_cause: A new fraud rule was too aggressive after a threshold change
resolution: Tuned the threshold and added a manual review queue instead of hard block

title: CDN serving wrong content type
symptoms: Some JavaScript files are served as plain text and fail to run
root_cause: The origin returned a wrong Content-Type that the CDN cached
resolution: Fixed the origin content type and purged affected cache entries

title: Database connection storms after restart
symptoms: A service restart triggers a connection spike that overwhelms the DB
root_cause: Every instance opened its full pool at once on startup
resolution: Added connection ramp-up jitter and a shared proxy pooler

title: Order webhook signature validation fails
symptoms: Partner cannot verify our webhook signatures
root_cause: The signing secret was rotated on our side but not shared with the partner
resolution: Coordinated secret rotation and supported dual secrets temporarily

title: Search index corruption
symptoms: Search returns errors for a subset of queries
root_cause: An index rebuild was interrupted and left segments in a bad state
resolution: Rebuilt the index cleanly with a blue-green swap

title: Notification preferences ignored
symptoms: Users still receive emails they unsubscribed from
root_cause: The preference check happened after the message was already queued
resolution: Moved the preference check before enqueueing the message

title: Payment page loads slowly
symptoms: The payment form takes a long time to become interactive
root_cause: A synchronous third-party fraud script blocked page rendering
resolution: Loaded the script asynchronously and deferred non-critical parts

title: Cart total miscalculated with discounts
symptoms: Cart total is wrong when multiple discounts stack
root_cause: Discount application order was non-deterministic across requests
resolution: Defined a fixed discount precedence and added tests

title: Excessive logging degraded performance
symptoms: A service slowed down sharply after a debug flag was left on
root_cause: Verbose debug logging was enabled in production by mistake
resolution: Disabled debug logging and gated it behind an environment check

title: Failed to renew OAuth tokens
symptoms: Integration with a partner stops working every hour
root_cause: The token refresh logic used an expired refresh token silently
resolution: Fixed the refresh flow and added alerting on refresh failures

title: User avatars not loading
symptoms: Profile pictures show as broken images
root_cause: The avatar bucket permissions were changed to private accidentally
resolution: Restored read permissions and added a permission audit alert

title: Order cancellation not refunding
symptoms: Cancelled orders are not triggering refunds
root_cause: The cancellation event was published to a topic with no subscriber
resolution: Wired the refund service to the cancellation topic and added a contract test

title: Slow startup blocking deploys
symptoms: New pods take too long to become ready, slowing rollouts
root_cause: The readiness probe waited on a warm-up that loaded a huge dataset
resolution: Streamed the dataset lazily and adjusted the readiness threshold

title: Duplicate user accounts created
symptoms: Some users end up with two accounts after signup
root_cause: A double form submission created two records before uniqueness was enforced
resolution: Added a unique constraint on email and debounced the submit

title: Timeouts calling the tax service
symptoms: Checkout intermittently fails at the tax calculation step
root_cause: The tax service was overloaded with no request caching
resolution: Added short-lived caching of tax rates by region

title: Broken pagination in listings
symptoms: Product listing pages skip or repeat items across pages
root_cause: Pagination used offset on a dataset that changed between page loads
resolution: Switched to keyset (cursor) pagination

title: Password field logged in plaintext
symptoms: Sensitive credentials appeared in application logs
root_cause: A request logging middleware captured the full request body
resolution: Redacted sensitive fields and purged the affected logs

title: Region outage caused full downtime
symptoms: The entire application was unavailable during a cloud region outage
root_cause: The application was deployed to a single availability region
resolution: Deployed to multiple regions with failover and DNS routing

title: Slow queries after data growth
symptoms: Several queries became slow as a table grew past millions of rows
root_cause: Queries relied on a scan that no longer fit in memory
resolution: Added appropriate indexes and archived old rows

title: Notification service dropped messages
symptoms: A batch of notifications was never delivered
root_cause: The message broker filled up and rejected new messages
resolution: Increased broker capacity and added backpressure handling

title: Incorrect stock shown after returns
symptoms: Returned items are not added back to available stock
root_cause: The returns flow updated the order but not the inventory ledger
resolution: Connected returns to the inventory service and reconciled counts

title: Checkout button unresponsive
symptoms: Clicking checkout does nothing on the first attempt
root_cause: A race between two scripts left the click handler unbound
resolution: Ensured deterministic script loading order and bound handlers on ready

title: Payment provider webhook duplicates
symptoms: The same payment webhook is processed multiple times
root_cause: The provider resent webhooks and our handler was not idempotent
resolution: Deduplicated by provider event ID with a processed-events table

title: Search downtime during reindex
symptoms: Search is unavailable while a full reindex runs
root_cause: Reindexing happened in place on the live index
resolution: Adopted blue-green indexing to reindex offline then swap

title: Mismatched order and payment amounts
symptoms: The captured amount sometimes differs from the order total
root_cause: The order total was recalculated after payment authorization
resolution: Locked the amount at authorization and validated before capture

title: Cron job ran twice
symptoms: A scheduled job executed twice, sending duplicate reports
root_cause: Two schedulers were active after a failover left both running
resolution: Added leader election so only one scheduler is active

title: Slow login due to external MFA
symptoms: Login is slow whenever multi-factor verification is required
root_cause: The MFA provider call had no timeout and occasionally hung
resolution: Added a timeout with a fallback and cached recent verifications

title: Inventory service memory pressure
symptoms: The inventory service restarts frequently under load
root_cause: An unbounded in-memory index grew with catalog size
resolution: Bounded the index and offloaded cold entries to the database

title: Emails marked as spam
symptoms: Transactional emails increasingly land in spam folders
root_cause: SPF and DKIM records were missing for a new sending domain
resolution: Configured SPF, DKIM, and DMARC and warmed up the domain

title: Failed graceful shutdown dropped requests
symptoms: In-flight requests are dropped during deployments
root_cause: The service exited before draining active connections
resolution: Added connection draining and honored termination grace periods
